title.en: The CCM Mode for Authentication and Confidentiality

entries.relatedPolicy: Related entries are distinct concepts; no merge or replacement is implied.

zh.principle: **标准**：CCM 认证与保密模式（The CCM Mode for Authentication and Confidentiality）。摘要第一句是模式定义：「This Recommendation defines a mode of operation, called CCM, for a symmetric key block cipher algorithm.」第二句写明组合方式：「CCM may be used to provide assurance of the confidentiality and the authenticity of computer data by combining the techniques of the Counter (CTR) mode and the Cipher Block Chaining-Message Authentication Code (CBC-MAC) algorithm.」关键词行把两面并列出来：「KEY WORDS: authenticated encryption; authentication; block cipher; confidentiality; cryptography; encryption; information security; message authentication code; mode of operation.」§1 交代其在系列中的位置：「This publication is the third Part in a series of Recommendations regarding modes of operation of symmetric key block cipher algorithms.」即本文件不提出新算法，只把两种既有原语装进同一套过程，认证与保密两面并列出现；密钥从哪里来、协议怎样取值都不在其规定之内。
zh.why: 要解决的是一次处理同时给出机密与认证：§3 写「CCM consists of two related processes: generation-encryption and decryption-verification, which combine two cryptographic primitives: counter mode encryption and cipher block chainingbased authentication.」并限定所用原语：「Only the forward cipher function of the block cipher algorithm is used within these primitives.」认证的相对优势另有一句：「A MAC provides stronger assurance of authenticity than a checksum or an error detecting code.」风险则落在密钥上：「The security properties of CCM depend, at a minimum, on the secrecy of the key.」四句合起来是本文件的立场：两个原语合用一把密钥，只要前向密码函数即可，代价是密钥保密成为最低前提。
zh.used: §5.1 的要求多为 shall 级：「The underlying block cipher algorithm shall be approved, and a secret key for the block cipher algorithm shall be generated uniformly at random, or close to uniformly at random」与「The key shall be kept secret and shall only be used for the CCM mode.」同节还给出调用总量的硬顶：「The total number of invocations of the block cipher algorithm during the lifetime of the key shall be limited to 261.」（此处的 261 是 2 的 61 次方在抽取时丢了上标）§5.3 把 nonce 写成不得重复：「The nonce shall be non-repeating in the sense that any two distinct data pairs to be protected by CCM during the lifetime of the key shall be assigned distinct nonces.」并补一句：「The nonce is not required to be random.」几处措辞层级一致：算法须批准、密钥须保密且专用、调用次数封顶、nonce 须唯一而随机性不作要求；五条都落在实现与密钥的取值上，没有一条涉及原语自身的强度。
zh.broken: 限度分层写明。适用面：§2「such standards and guidelines shall not apply to national security systems.」使用形态：§3「CCM is not designed to support partial processing or stream processing.」底层密码：§3「thus, CCM cannot be used with the Triple Data Encryption Algorithm」。被组合的原语本身不获批准：§5.2「This Recommendation does not approve CBC-MAC as an authentication mode outside of the context of the CCM specification」。密钥工作另交他文：§5.1「Key establishment and key management are outside the scope of this Recommendation.」标签长度亦有条件：附录 B.2「a value of Tlen that is less than 64 shall not be used without a careful analysis of the risks of accepting inauthentic data as authentic.」六处限度分属不同层：适用面排除国家安全系统，使用形态要求整包数据到位，可选密码受分组长度约束，被借用的 CBC-MAC 本身不获批准，密钥工作另交他文，短标签须另做风险分析。
zh.history: 扉页连读为「NIST Special Publication 800-38C Recommendation for Block Cipher Modes of Operation: The CCM Mode for Authentication and Confidentiality Morris Dworkin」，分册标题用 Confidentiality 而非 Privacy；日期行写「May 2004 (errata update 07-20-2007; corrected value of parameter B on p.19)」，即 2004 年 5 月初版并于 2007 年 7 月 20 日并入勘误。引用行给出页数与日期：「Natl.Inst.Stand.Technol.Spec.Publ.800-38C 25 pages (May 2004) CODEN: NSPUE2」，本份文本无 DOI 行。附录 A 交代标准化前的出处：「With these functions, this specification of CCM is essentially equivalent to the specification of CCM in the draft amendment [4] to the IEEE Standard 802.11 for wireless local area networks [5].」题页、引用行与附录合起来给出这份副本的版次事实：分册号与标题、单一作者、初版月份、并入勘误的日期与页数，以及该模式在标准化之前的 WLAN 出处。

en.principle: **Standard**: The CCM Mode for Authentication and Confidentiality (CCM 认证与保密模式). The first abstract sentence is the mode definition: "This Recommendation defines a mode of operation, called CCM, for a symmetric key block cipher algorithm." The second gives the combination: "CCM may be used to provide assurance of the confidentiality and the authenticity of computer data by combining the techniques of the Counter (CTR) mode and the Cipher Block Chaining-Message Authentication Code (CBC-MAC) algorithm." The keyword line carries both services side by side: "KEY WORDS: authenticated encryption; authentication; block cipher; confidentiality; cryptography; encryption; information security; message authentication code; mode of operation." Clause 1 places the part in the series: "This publication is the third Part in a series of Recommendations regarding modes of operation of symmetric key block cipher algorithms." No new algorithm is proposed: two existing primitives are put into one process, authentication and confidentiality appear together, and neither the origin of the key nor the values a protocol chooses falls inside this specification.
en.why: The problem is obtaining confidentiality and authentication in one pass: §3 states "CCM consists of two related processes: generation-encryption and decryption-verification, which combine two cryptographic primitives: counter mode encryption and cipher block chainingbased authentication." and bounds the primitives: "Only the forward cipher function of the block cipher algorithm is used within these primitives." The advantage of the authentication half is put in one sentence: "A MAC provides stronger assurance of authenticity than a checksum or an error detecting code." The burden is stated as a minimum condition: "The security properties of CCM depend, at a minimum, on the secrecy of the key." Together the four sentences give the document position: one key serves both primitives, only the forward cipher function is needed, and key secrecy is the floor.
en.used: Section 5.1 is written mostly at shall level: "The underlying block cipher algorithm shall be approved, and a secret key for the block cipher algorithm shall be generated uniformly at random, or close to uniformly at random" and "The key shall be kept secret and shall only be used for the CCM mode." The same clause sets a hard ceiling on cipher calls: "The total number of invocations of the block cipher algorithm during the lifetime of the key shall be limited to 261." (the printed 261 is this extraction dropping the superscript of 2 to the power 61) Section 5.3 makes the nonce a non-repetition requirement: "The nonce shall be non-repeating in the sense that any two distinct data pairs to be protected by CCM during the lifetime of the key shall be assigned distinct nonces." and adds "The nonce is not required to be random." The wording level is uniform: the algorithm must be approved, the key stays secret and dedicated, the number of calls is capped, uniqueness is required of the nonce while randomness is not, and all five obligations bear on the implementation and its key values rather than on the strength of the primitives themselves.
en.broken: The limits are written layer by layer. Applicability: §2 states "such standards and guidelines shall not apply to national security systems." Operating shape: §3 states "CCM is not designed to support partial processing or stream processing." The cipher choice follows from the block size: §3 gives "thus, CCM cannot be used with the Triple Data Encryption Algorithm". The borrowed primitive is not itself approved: §5.2 states "This Recommendation does not approve CBC-MAC as an authentication mode outside of the context of the CCM specification". Key work is handed elsewhere: §5.1 says "Key establishment and key management are outside the scope of this Recommendation." And the tag length carries a condition: Appendix B.2 states "a value of Tlen that is less than 64 shall not be used without a careful analysis of the risks of accepting inauthentic data as authentic." The six limits sit at different levels: national security systems are outside applicability, whole packets are required, the cipher choice is fixed by the block size, the borrowed CBC-MAC gains no approval of its own, key work belongs to other documents, and a short tag needs a separate risk analysis.
en.history: The masthead reads "NIST Special Publication 800-38C Recommendation for Block Cipher Modes of Operation: The CCM Mode for Authentication and Confidentiality Morris Dworkin", the part title using Confidentiality rather than Privacy; the date line reads "May 2004 (errata update 07-20-2007; corrected value of parameter B on p.19)", a May 2004 original with an errata update of 20 July 2007. The citation line gives extent and date: "Natl. Inst. Stand. Technol. Spec. Publ. 800-38C 25 pages (May 2004) CODEN: NSPUE2", and this copy contains no DOI line. Appendix A records the pre-standardisation source: "With these functions, this specification of CCM is essentially equivalent to the specification of CCM in the draft amendment [4] to the IEEE Standard 802.11 for wireless local area networks [5]."

zh: CCM：把 CTR 加密与 CBC-MAC 认证合用的分组密码模式。
associated data (A)：只认证不加密的数据，例如头部。
nonce (N)：赋给一对数据的取值，同密钥期内不得重复。
Tlen：内部 MAC 的比特长度，模式参数。
t / q：附录 A 中分别表示 MAC 字节数与长度字段字节数的参数。
en: CCM: the block cipher mode that combines CTR encryption with CBC-MAC authentication.
Payload (P): the data that is both authenticated and encrypted.
Associated data (A): data authenticated but not encrypted, for example a header.
Nonce (N): the value assigned to a data pair, which may not repeat within the key.
Tlen: the bit length of the internal MAC, a parameter of the mode.
t / q: the parameters of Appendix A giving the MAC length and the length-field length in octets.
